_comment: ADR-0021 — the calendar block rule exists twice: the server writes Google events (apps/api/src/lib/mirror.js) and the device writes Apple events (apps/app/lib/src/features/calendar/apple/apple_mirror.dart). Two mirrors that disagree in front of the user is what DESIGN §17 D1 forbids, so both suites assert this file. Times are WALL clock with no zone attached: the server evaluates them against the task's timezone, the device against its own, and the arithmetic must land on the same wall time either way.

cases.name: an ordinary time gets a plain 30-minute block
the default 23:59 due time is pulled back, not spilled into tomorrow
23:40 is clamped back to the last half hour
midnight belongs to the day that starts, not the one that ended
the last day of a month does not leak into the next one
the last day of a year does not leak into the next one
